response.justification: Despite extensive software engineering experience, the candidate lacks direct C++ development experience in industrial automation, high-performance systems, or secure embedded environments required for this role; their work centers on JavaScript/TypeScript, DLang, and web stacks with minimal evidence of STL, multi-threading, message brokers, IEC 62443, or industrial protocols.
strengths: Strong full-stack and cross-platform development experience across diverse technologies
Demonstrated leadership in open-source projects and technical mentoring
Proven ability to deliver complex systems with test-driven and agile practices
concerns: No demonstrable professional C++ or STL experience in recent roles
Lacks exposure to industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) or automation protocols (OPC UA, Modbus)
No evidence of building multi-threaded, low-latency, or message-broker-based systems in C++
